tools.name: Machine_GetComponents
tools.description: Read this machine's component names, descriptions, and whether each component has an assigned GameObject. Call before answering machine component questions. Use the returned names exactly.

tools.name: Machine_ShowAnswer
tools.description: Highlight one machine component and display an answer above it. Call for every component question, including follow-up questions. The previous highlight and label are replaced. Use an exact component name returned by Machine_GetComponents.

component.description: Exact component identifier, for example PumpCasing or ElectricMotor.

answer.description: A short plain-text answer to the user's current question, grounded in the component description.
